title: Iran fight events z>1 -> UAE short 3d
hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] Iran fight-event count 20d z-score > 1 leads UAE ETF returns lower by 1-3 days (-); tighter subset of conflict events, trade short UAE 3d [gdelt.irn.fight_events -> finance.UAE.log_return] (parent: R2-0081)
message: Weakly supported: r=-0.18 at lag -1 (n=390) but short-UAE 1d rule hit_rate 49%, sharpe 0.54, validity 0; OOS war-period 18 trades 67% hit. Not actionable.

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.irn.fight_events rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short UAE next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] Null control: Iran fight-event 20d z-score > 1 should NOT predict Japan ETF (EWJ) returns at 1-3d lag; if it does, the UAE effect is a global risk-off proxy rather than Gulf-specific [gdelt.irn.fight_events -> finance.EWJ.log_return] (parent: R2-0181)
